Business Intelligence & Analytics.description_en:
Organizations everywhere are increasingly relying on an analytically literate workforce to support their decision-making, optimization and innovation efforts. This online self-paced course offers techniques for building strong analytics literacy in the workplace and explores the benefits of doing so. Participants will learn about common analytics pitfalls and discover best practices for supporting effective analytics practices in their organization.

Topics include:

· distinguishing between different types of analytics

· sequencing the four steps in the analytics development process

· outlining the stages in advancing the application of business analytics

· recognizing the most common mistakes when using analytics

· applying best practices for establishing and supporting an analytical organizational culture

Notes:

This course was developed with subject matter support provided by the International Institute for Analytics (www.iianalytics.com).

Automation Frameworks and Digital Asset.description_en:
In today's digital workplace, information has become a strategic asset that must be safeguarded and managed properly. This course provides a practical guide to the information management (IM) methods, tools and activities that support an effective departmental IM program. Participants will learn how to use a function-based classification structure, establish retention specifications and follow the proper process for disposing of information resources.

Topics include:

• applying function-based methodologies 

• documenting practices and procedures 

• developing retention specifications to facilitate the disposition process

Prerequisites:

Information Management: Supporting Programs and Services (I230) is a prerequisite for this course.

Notes:

This course is divided into three 3 hour sessions scheduled over a one-week period.
Automation Frameworks and Digital Asset.title_fr: Méthodes et outils de gestion de l'information (COR509)
Automation Frameworks and Digital Asset.description_fr:
Dans l'environnement de travail numérique d'aujourd'hui, l'information est devenue une ressource stratégique qui doit être protégée et gérée adéquatement. Ce cours présente de façon concrète les méthodes, les outils et les activités de gestion de l'information (GI) qui favorisent l'efficacité des programmes ministériels de GI. Les participants apprendront à utiliser une structure de classification basée sur les fonctions, à établir des critères de conservation et à suivre les démarches appropriées pour éliminer des ressources documentaires.

Sujets traités :

• appliquer des méthodes axées sur les fonctions; 

• consigner les pratiques et les procédures; 

• établir des critères de conservation afin de simplifier le processus de disposition.

Préalables :

Le cours La gestion de l'information à l'appui des programmes et des services (I230) est un préalable à ce cours.

Remarques :

Ce cours est divisé en trois séances de 3 heures réparties sur une semaine.

• selecting a contractor

AI-Driven Statistical Methodologies.description_en:
Having a fundamental understanding of statistical analysis methods increases your ability to effectively apply analytics to your decision-making. This online self-paced course introduces the fundamental concepts of statistical analysis, including data distribution, deviation, correlation, regression, and clustering.
Participants will learn how to use statistical analysis methods to better communicate with data analysts and other data professionals as part of their work routine.

Topics include:

· distinguishing between the three measures of central tendency

· recognizing the ways that deviation can be indicated

· identifying the different types of data correlation

· distinguishing between regression types

· identifying the key goals of effective clustering

Notes:

This course was developed with subject matter support provided by the International Institute for Analytics (www.iianalytics.com).

Working with a team while balancing being an effective leader is part of the project management process. This online self-paced course explores the types of management and leadership styles, and best practices for fostering a team culture. Digital Project Management & Team Arbitr.description_en:
Effective project management requires project managers to properly define the roles and responsibilities of their project team. This online self-paced course explores the characteristics of core project roles, including the project manager, coordinator, sponsor, team member, subject matter expert and stakeholder. Participants will learn about the different roles and responsibilities involved in project management, including the differences between project management and project leadership.

 

Topics include:

- defining project management roles and outlining the responsibilities of each

Digital Project Management & Team Arbitr.description_fr:
Afin d'assurer une gestion de projet efficace, les gestionnaires de projet doivent définir adéquatement les rôles et responsabilités au sein de leur équipe. Ce cours en ligne à rythme libre explore les caractéristiques des rôles fondamentaux liés à un projet, notamment la direction, la coordination, la promotion et les rôles de membre de l'équipe, d'expert métier et de partie prenante. Les participants en apprendront sur les rôles et responsabilités qui entrent en ligne de compte dans la gestion de projet, y compris les différences entre la gestion et le leadership.

 

Sujets traités :

- définir les rôles liés à la gestion de projet et présenter les responsabilités de chacune et chacun;
- faire la distinction entre la gestion de projet et le leadership d'un projet;
- examiner les principales caractéristiques de l'intelligence émotionnelle dans la gestion de projet.

 

Remarques :

Ce cours s'adresse à tous les fonctionnaires, qu'ils aient ou non de l'expérience en gestion de projet. Le matériel est conforme à la septième édition du Guide PMBOK®.

La réussite des 26 cours de série de cours CAPM® peut être prise en compte dans les conditions d’admissibilité à l’examen payant d’Associé certifié en gestion de projet (CAPM®) du Project Management Institute (PMI).
 
L’examen CAPM® n’est pas offert par l’École de la fonction publique du Canada. Les apprenants qui souhaitent le passer sont responsables de vérifier leur admissibilité directement auprès du PMI.

Participants will examine a series of multifaceted scenarios that build upon the courses included in the Authority Delegation Training Program.

 

Topics include:

 

- functioning in the government's accountability framework
- reviewing the responsibilities and roles of executives
- leading and managing people
- procuring and managing public funds, programs and assets

 

Notes:

 

Learners must successfully complete this assessment five years after their initial certifications to revalidate their ability to exercise their delegated authorities. Completing the authority delegation training and assessments does not entitle you to exercise signing authority. Consult the Directive on Delegation of Spending and Financial Authorities for the specific conditions.

 

Participants must complete the scenarios, exercises and validation questions in their entirety to complete this assessment.

 

Learn more about the Authority Delegation Training Program.
